p: sat on the throne of his: That is, had rest and quietness.
beds were of gold and silver: Which they used in those countries instead of tables.
state of the king: As was befitting for so magnificent a king.
compel: No one was forced to drink more than it pleased him.
seventh day: Which was the last day of the feast that the king made for the people as in Es 1:5.
which knew the times: Who had experience in things as they had learned by diligent marking in continuance of time.
king's face: Who were his chief counsellors that always had access to him.
wrong to the king only: By her disobedience she has given an example to all women to do the same to their husbands.
deed of the queen shall come: That is, her disobedience.
ladies of Persia and Media say: Meaning, that they would take the first opportunity to do the same and the rest of the women would also do the same.
no more before king Ahasuerus: Let her be divorced and another made queen.
great: For he had under him a hundred and twenty-seven countries.
bear rule in his own house: That is, that the wife should be subject to the husband and at his commandment.
